title: They left the book

D0.outcome: Explains what to do when the opponent leaves the known line: apply the principles and look for what the new move threatens.

D1.outcome: At the first deviation in a model line, names what the new move threatens and a principled reply.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions after a deviation, replies well or sees that the deviation is harmless.

D3.outcome: Calculates a reply when the deviation sets a trap, and says which principle the deviation breaks.

misconceptions: An opponent who left the book has made a mistake.
sources: docs/council-synthesis.md CD-7 ('they left the book' from Tier 1)
conditions: The learner can calculate and the principles are internalised.
contrasts: Treating every deviation as an error.
A deviation that wins by transposing to a line the learner does not know.
A forced line with no choice.
